evidence_candidates.source_locator: The Science, The Impact, and Summary sections
evidence_candidates.excerpt: The DOE summary says heterogeneous supercomputer memory requires runtime data-placement software because applications and existing software do not automatically map data well across fast-small and slow-large tiers; the cited framework monitors use and moves individual objects on real systems.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: AI-for-science memory architecture evaluation must include placement-policy quality and runtime migration overhead, not only device bandwidth and capacity.
